from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyNetProfit(BaseModel):
    """One data point of net profit (deducting non-recurring items) from a financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company the report belongs to, e.g., 东阿阿胶")
    period: str = Field(description="The fiscal period covered, e.g., Q1 2022, Q1 2023, Q1 2024")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The exact label of the metric as written")
    profit_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of the reported net profit")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 元")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_net_profits: list[QuarterlyNetProfit]
